title: Lab Safety Induction
summary: Your first visit to the ECH chemistry lab: find the safety equipment, put on your PPE and learn the rules that keep everyone safe.
subject: chemistry
objectives: Put on goggles, lab coat and gloves correctly
Know the hazard symbols on chemical bottles
Know what to do in an emergency

steps.title: Read the label
steps.instruction: Look closely at the acid bottle and read its hazard label.
hints: Select the bottle on the shelf and choose "Look closer".
Corrosive means it can burn skin and eyes.
steps.say: Always read the label before you pick up any chemical.

question.prompt: What does the CORROSIVE symbol warn you about?
choices: It can burn skin and eyes
question.explanation: Corrosive substances destroy living tissue on contact, so wear goggles and gloves.

question.prompt: Acid splashes into your eye. What should you do FIRST?
choices: Rinse with running water for at least 10 minutes and tell the teacher
Wait to see if it hurts
Add an alkali to neutralise it
question.explanation: Flush immediately with lots of water (eyewash station) and report it. Never try to neutralise chemicals in an eye.

question.prompt: Where should you eat your snack?
choices: At your bench if you are careful
question.explanation: Never eat or drink in a laboratory: food can be contaminated by chemicals.
